definitions.explanation: The positive outcome or fruit of one's efforts or work.

examples.japanese: {努力|どりょく}の{成果|せいか}が{出|で}た。
examples.english: The results of my efforts have shown.

examples.japanese: {研究|けんきゅう}の{成果|せいか}を{発表|はっぴょう}する。
examples.english: To present the results of the research.

examples.japanese: {成果|せいか}を{上|あ}げることができた。
examples.english: We were able to achieve results.

notes:
USAGE:
Usually refers to positive achievements or outcomes:
・{成果|せいか}を{出|だ}す (to produce results)
・{成果|せいか}を{上|あ}げる (to achieve results)
・{成果|せいか}が{出|で}る (results appear)
・{成果|せいか}を{収|おさ}める (to achieve success)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{研究|けんきゅう}{成果|せいか} (research findings)
・{学習|がくしゅう}{成果|せいか} (learning outcomes)
・{成果|せいか}{主義|しゅぎ} (results-oriented approach, performance-based)
・{成果物|せいかぶつ} (deliverable, output)

NOTE:
{成果|せいか} implies successful or productive results. For neutral or negative results, use {結果|けっか}.

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{結果|けっか} - result (neutral)
・{実績|じっせき} - track record, achievements
・{業績|ぎょうせき} - performance, accomplishments
